Scenario: The Docker QA environment starts with its own data
Preconditions: Docker Desktop running, QA_SESSION_SECRET in the root .env. `pnpm qa:up` and `pnpm qa:seed` done (section 1).
Steps:
1. Run `pnpm qa:ps`.
2. Run `pnpm qa:reset` (a dry run: it only shows what a reset would delete).
3. Open http://127.0.0.1:3336/api/health, then http://127.0.0.1:4203.
Expected Result: pet-adoption-qa-mongodb, -api and -web are "healthy". The dry run names database "pet-adoption-qa" and volume "pet-adoption-qa_uploads_data", and deletes nothing. Health returns {"status":"ok"}. The web app shows the 14 seeded pets, most with a photo, and none of your development pets.

Scenario: A visitor browses the pet list and opens a pet
Preconditions: Signed out. At least 2 pets exist. Seed data: any pet.
Steps:
1. Open /pets.
2. Click anywhere on a pet's card (the whole card is a link; there is no separate "View details" button).
3. Click "Back to pets".
Expected Result: Cards show name, species, age, status and photo or "No image available". Clicking the card opens that pet's page. The detail page shows the description and status badge. Edit and Delete are not shown. The adoption section says "Interested in adopting <name>? Sign in to apply".

Scenario: Search, filter and sort the pet list
Preconditions: Pets with similar names and different species/status exist (e.g. demo data: Max, Maxi, Bella, Bello). Seed data: search "max" (Max, Maxi) and "bel" (Bella, Bello).
Steps:
1. Type part of a name in "Search pets by name..." and wait a moment.
2. Choose a species in "Filter by species".
3. Choose a status in "Filter by status".
4. Change "Sort by" to each option.
Expected Result: Results update after you stop typing and match case-insensitively anywhere in the name. "<n> pets found" matches the cards. Filters combine with the search. Sort order follows the chosen option. The URL contains the search, filters and sort.

Scenario: Pet list pagination keeps its state in the URL
Preconditions: More than 12 pets exist (demo data has 14). Seed data: 14 pets.
Steps:
1. On /pets click "Next".
2. Open a pet on page 2, then use the browser Back button.
3. Refresh the page.
4. Change a filter.
Expected Result: "Page 2 of 2" is shown and the URL has page=2. Back and refresh return to the same page with the same filters. Changing a filter goes back to page 1. "Previous" is disabled on page 1 and "Next" on the last page.

Scenario: Register a new account
Preconditions: Signed out. An email address not registered yet.
Steps:
1. Click "Register".
2. Fill Name, Email and a password of at least 8 characters.
3. Click "Create account".
Expected Result: You land on /pets, signed in. The header shows a button with your name (the account menu) instead of "Sign in" and "Register"; opening it lists "Applications" and "Sign out" among the other items. A welcome toast appears.

Scenario: Registration form validation
Preconditions: Signed out, on /register.
Steps:
1. Click "Create account" with all fields empty.
2. Enter an invalid email and a 5-character password, submit again.
Expected Result: Empty form: "Name is required.", "Email is required." and "Password must be at least 8 characters." Second attempt: "Enter a valid email address." and the password message. No request is sent and no account is created.

Scenario: Register with an email that already exists
Preconditions: An existing account (e.g. Owner). Seed data: register ANA@DEMO.EXAMPLE.COM.
Steps: 1. Signed out, register again with the same email in different letter case (e.g. OWNER@...).
Expected Result: Inline error "An account with this email already exists." You stay signed out on /register.

Scenario: Sign in with valid credentials
Preconditions: An existing account. Signed out.
Steps:
1. Click "Sign in".
2. Enter email and password.
3. Click "Sign in".
Expected Result: You land on /pets, signed in. Toast "Welcome back, <name>!". The header shows a button with your name (the account menu) instead of "Sign in" and "Register".

Scenario: Sign in with a wrong password
Preconditions: An existing account. Signed out.
Steps: 1. Sign in with the right email and a wrong password.
Expected Result: Inline error "Incorrect email or password." You stay on /login, signed out.

Scenario: The session survives a refresh and a new tab
Preconditions: Signed in.
Steps:
1. Refresh the page.
2. Open /applications in a new tab of the same browser window.
Expected Result: You are still signed in in both tabs. The Applications page loads without asking you to sign in.

Scenario: Sign out
Preconditions: Signed in, on /applications.
Steps:
1. Open the account menu (your name in the header) and click "Sign out".
2. Open /applications again (or use the browser Back button).
Expected Result: Toast "You have been signed out." The header shows "Sign in" and "Register". /applications redirects to /login.

Scenario: Protected pages redirect to sign-in and return afterwards
Preconditions: Signed out.
Steps:
1. Open /pets/new.
2. Sign in on the page you are sent to.
Expected Result: You are redirected to /login. After signing in you are back on /pets/new ("Add a pet"). The same works for /applications.

Scenario: Signing out in one tab affects the other tab
Preconditions: Signed in, two tabs open on a pet you could apply for.
Steps:
1. Sign out in tab 1.
2. In tab 2 (still showing the signed-in view) submit an application or save a form.
Expected Result: Nothing is saved. Tab 2 switches to the signed-out state: the pet page shows "Sign in to apply" (an error "Please sign in to continue." may show briefly); a form page redirects to /login.

Scenario: Repeated failed sign-ins are rate-limited
Preconditions: An existing account. Run this last: it blocks that account from this IP for 15 minutes. Seed data: use an address that has no account, e.g. ratelimit@qa.example.com, so no demo account gets blocked.
Steps: 1. Sign in with a wrong password 6 times for the same email.
Expected Result:
Attempts 1-5 show "Incorrect email or password."; the 6th shows "Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again."
Cleanup: Wait 15 minutes, or run `pnpm qa:down` and `pnpm qa:up` (the counters reset; the QA data stays).

Scenario: Signed-in users are sent away from sign-in and register pages
Preconditions: Signed in.
Steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Open /register.
Expected Result: Both pages immediately redirect you (to /pets) instead of showing the forms.

Scenario: Create a pet
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner.
Steps:
1. Click "Add a pet".
2. Fill Name, Species, Age (whole number) and Description. Set Sex to "Female", "Breed or type (optional)" to "Labrador mix", and under "Gets along with" set Children to "Yes".
3. Click "Create pet".
Expected Result: Toast "Pet created successfully." You land on the new pet's page with status "Available" and the Edit and Delete controls. The facts show Sex "Female" and Breed "Labrador mix"; "Home and lifestyle" shows Children "Gets along well" and the other answers as "Not known yet". The card in the list shows "Female" and a "Good with children" chip. The pet appears at the top of /pets (newest first).

Scenario: Pet form validation
Preconditions: Signed in, on "Add a pet".
Steps:
1. Click "Create pet" with empty fields.
2. Enter age "-1" or "2.5" and submit.
3. Enter age "101" and submit.
Expected Result: Messages "Name is required.", "Age is required." / "Age must be a non-negative whole number." and "Description is required." appear. Age 101 shows "Age must be at most 100 years." (0 to 100 is allowed). Nothing is saved.

Scenario: Edit a pet
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner, on one of your pets. Seed data: Ana edits Nala.
Steps:
1. Click "Edit pet".
2. Change name, age and description.
3. Click "Save changes".
Expected Result: Toast "Pet updated successfully." The detail page and the list show the new values. The status is unchanged.

Scenario: Delete a pet after confirming
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner, a pet with no pending or accepted applications. Seed data: create a pet just for this and delete it (demo pets have applications).
Steps:
1. On the pet page click "Delete".
2. Click "Cancel".
3. Click "Delete" again, then "Yes, delete".
Expected Result: Cancel keeps the pet. After confirming, toast "<name> was deleted.", you are taken to the list and the pet is gone.

Scenario: Other users cannot edit or delete a pet
Preconditions: Signed in as Adopter. A pet owned by Owner. Seed data: Jelena opens Ana's Max.
Steps:
1. Open the Owner's pet.
2. Open /pets/<that pet id>/edit directly.
Expected Result: No Edit or Delete controls on the pet page. The edit URL shows "You can only edit pets you posted." without a form.

Scenario: A pet with an active application cannot be deleted
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner, a pet with a pending (or accepted) application. Seed data: Ana deletes Max (Jelena's application is pending).
Steps: 1. On the pet page click "Delete", then "Yes, delete".
Expected Result: Error toast "This pet has open or accepted adoption applications and cannot be deleted." The pet stays.

Scenario: Edit page for a missing pet or failed load
Preconditions: Signed in.
Steps:
1. Open /pets/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/edit (valid-looking id that does not exist).
2. Open your own pet's edit page with the browser offline (DevTools > Network > Offline), then go online and click "Try again".
Expected Result: Missing pet: "Pet not found" and "Back to pets", no "Try again". Offline: "The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again." with "Try again", which loads the form once online.

Scenario: Add several photos when creating a pet
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner. 2–3 JPEG or PNG files under 5 MB each. Seed data: Ana creates a new pet.
Steps:
1. On "Add a pet" fill the fields, click "Add photos" and choose 2–3 files at once.
2. Click "Create pet".
Expected Result: Before saving, each file shows as a preview tile ("Photo 1", "Photo 2"…), the first marked "Main photo", and the hint says "Photos: N of 5." After saving, the pet page shows the first photo large with a thumbnail per photo, and the card in the list shows the first photo. Opening a photo in a new tab works (URL under http://127.0.0.1:3336/uploads/pets/).

Scenario: Add and remove individual photos when editing
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner, a pet with at least 2 photos. Seed data: Ana edits Max (5 photos); this changes Max's seeded photos (pnpm qa:reset --yes, then pnpm qa:seed restores them).
Steps:
1. Edit the pet and click "Remove photo 1".
2. Click "Add photos" and choose one new file.
3. Click "Save changes".
Expected Result: The removed photo disappears from the form at once and the next photo becomes "Main photo"; with Max, removing one re-enables "Add photos". After saving ("Pet updated successfully."), the pet page shows the remaining photos in order with the new one last, and the removed photo is gone everywhere.

Scenario: Wrong file types and too large files are refused before upload
Preconditions: Signed in, on the pet form. One valid JPEG, plus a GIF (or PDF) and an image larger than 5 MB.
Steps: 1. Click "Add photos" and choose all three files at once (switch the file dialog to "All files"; it offers only JPEG, PNG and WebP).
Expected Result: The valid file is added as a preview. For the others: "<file name>: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image." and "<file name>: The photo must be at most 5 MB." They are not sent.

Scenario: A non-image renamed to .png is rejected by the server
Preconditions: Signed in, on "Add a pet". A text file renamed to fake.png, plus one real JPEG.
Steps: 1. Fill the form, add both files with "Add photos", click "Create pet".
Expected Result: The pet is created, then the toast says "The pet was saved, but the photos were not: Only still JPEG, PNG and WebP photos are supported." The pet has no photos: the server stores all files of an upload or none. (Assumes the browser reports the type from the extension, so the client check passes; unverified.)

Scenario: At most 5 photos per pet, counting the existing ones
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner, a pet with 3 photos. Seed data: Ana edits Rex.
Steps:
1. Click "Add photos" and choose 3 files at once.
2. Click "Save changes".
Expected Result: Two files are added; the third shows "<file name>: Not added: a pet can have at most 5 photos." The hint says "Photos: 5 of 5." and "Add photos" is disabled. After saving, the pet has 5 photos.

Scenario: The pet page shows a photo gallery
Preconditions: Signed out is fine. A pet with several photos, one with one photo, one with none. Seed data: Max (5), Toby (1), Kiki (0).
Steps:
1. Open the pet with several photos; click the second thumbnail.
2. Press Tab until a thumbnail is focused and press Enter.
3. Open the pet with one photo, then the one without photos; check them at a narrow window width too.
Expected Result: The large photo switches to the chosen thumbnail, which is highlighted; thumbnails work with the keyboard and show a focus ring. A single photo shows no thumbnails; a pet without photos shows no photo area. Thumbnails wrap on narrow screens.

Scenario: Apply to adopt another user's pet
Preconditions: Signed in as Adopter. An available pet owned by Owner. Seed data: Jelena applies for the pet Ana created in PETS-004, so it repeats without a reset (or Bella).
Steps:
1. Open the pet.
2. Write a message in "Why would you like to adopt <name>?".
3. Click "Send application".
Expected Result: Toast "Your application was sent." The section shows "Your application:" "Pending" and "Withdraw". The pet status becomes "Pending". The application is listed under "My applications".

Scenario: Application message validation
Preconditions: Signed in as Adopter, on an available pet.
Steps:
1. Click "Send application" with an empty message.
2. Paste a message longer than 2000 characters and send.
Expected Result: "Please write a short message." and "The message must be at most 2000 characters." No application is created.

Scenario: Owners cannot apply for their own pet
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner. Seed data: Ana opens Max.
Steps: 1. Open one of your own pets.
Expected Result: No application form. A "Review applications" button links to /applications instead.

Scenario: Withdraw a pending application and apply again
Preconditions: Signed in as Adopter with a pending application that is the only one for that pet. Seed data: Jelena withdraws her application for Kiki (consumes it: reset QA to repeat).
Steps:
1. On /applications under "My applications" click "Withdraw".
2. Open the pet.
Expected Result: Toast "Application withdrawn." Status "Withdrawn" with no buttons. The pet is "Available" again and shows the application form, so you can apply again.

Scenario: A duplicate application is refused
Preconditions: Signed in as Adopter. The same available pet open in two tabs. Seed data: Jelena applies for Coco in two tabs.
Steps:
1. Send an application in tab 1.
2. In tab 2 (still showing the form) send another one.
Expected Result: Tab 2 shows "You have already applied for this pet." inline. Only one application exists.

Scenario: Adopted pets cannot be applied for
Preconditions: Signed in as a user who did not apply for the adopted pet. Seed data: Marko opens Maxi (adopted by Jelena).
Steps: 1. Open the adopted pet.
Expected Result: Status badge "Adopted" and no application form.

Scenario: The owner sees received applications with contact details
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner. Adopter has applied for one of your pets. Seed data: Ana sees Jelena's application from APP-001 (or the one for Max).
Steps: 1. Open the account menu (your name in the header) and choose "Applications".
Expected Result: Under "Applications for my pets" the application shows the pet name (link), "Submitted <date>", "Applicant: <name> (<email>)", the message, "Pending", and "Accept" and "Reject".

Scenario: Accepting adopts the pet and rejects the other applications
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner. Two pending applications for the same pet (Adopter and Adopter 2). Seed data: Rex has pending applications from Luka and Marko: accept Luka's (consumes Rex).
Steps:
1. Click "Accept" on Adopter's application.
2. Look at Adopter 2's application and at the pet.
Expected Result: Toast "Application accepted. The pet is now adopted." Adopter's application is "Accepted", Adopter 2's is "Rejected", neither has buttons. The pet is "Adopted". Adopter 2 sees "Rejected" under "My applications".

Scenario: Rejecting the last pending application makes the pet available
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner. A pet with exactly one pending application. Seed data: reject Luka's application for Toby (consumes it).
Steps:
1. Click "Reject" on it.
2. Open the pet.
Expected Result: Toast "Application rejected." Status "Rejected", no buttons. The pet is "Available". The rejected applicant sees "Rejected" and no new form for that pet.

Scenario: Application lists are paginated independently
Preconditions: Owner with more than 10 received applications (demo data: Ana has 11). Seed data: Ana (11 received applications).
Steps:
1. Open /applications.
2. Click "Next" in "Applications for my pets".
3. Refresh, then use Back.
Expected Result: Page 2 shows the 11th application and "Page 2 of 2". The URL has receivedPage=2. "My applications" stays on its own page 1. Refresh keeps the page.

Scenario: Applications are private
Preconditions: Adopter applied for an Owner pet. Signed in as Adopter 2 (not involved). Seed data: Marko does not see Jelena's application for Max.
Steps: 1. Open /applications.
Expected Result: Neither list shows that application or the Adopter's email.

Scenario: A stale decision in a second tab is refused
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner. Two pending applications for one pet; /applications open in two tabs. Seed data: needs Rex untouched, so run it instead of OWN-002 or after a QA reset.
Steps:
1. Tab 1: accept application 1.
2. Tab 2 (not refreshed): click "Reject" on application 1, then "Accept" on application 2.
Expected Result: Reject shows the error toast "This application has already been decided or withdrawn." Accept shows "This pet is no longer available for adoption." Nothing changes; refresh tab 2 to see application 1 "Accepted" and application 2 "Rejected".

Scenario: Empty application lists and a page past the end
Preconditions: Signed in as a user with no applications. Seed data: register a new account for the empty lists; Ana for page 9.
Steps:
1. Open /applications.
2. Open /applications?receivedPage=9 as a user with some received applications.
Expected Result: "No one has applied for your pets yet." and "You haven't applied to adopt any pets yet." Past the end: "There are no applications on this page." with "Go to the first page".

Scenario: Switch the language; it is remembered
Preconditions: Any page.
Steps:
1. Choose "Srpski" in the language selector in the header.
2. Navigate to another page, then refresh.
3. Switch back to "English".
Expected Result: The interface switches immediately (title "Udomljavanje ljubimaca", buttons and labels in Serbian) and stays Serbian after navigation and refresh. Pet names and descriptions are not translated (user content).

Scenario: Validation messages already on screen switch language
Preconditions: On /login, signed out.
Steps:
1. Click "Sign in" with empty fields.
2. Switch to "Srpski".
Expected Result: "Email is required." changes to "Email je obavezan." without resubmitting.

Scenario: The API is unreachable
Preconditions: On /pets. Use DevTools > Network > Offline (stopping the QA API would delete its data).
Steps:
1. Go offline and change a filter.
2. Go online and change the filter again.
Expected Result: After a few seconds (network errors are retried) "The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again." Once online the list loads normally.

Scenario: Unknown pages and pet list pages past the end
Preconditions: Any user.
Steps:
1. Open /does-not-exist.
2. Open /pets?page=99.
3. Open /pets?page=abc.
Expected Result: "Page not found" with "Back to pets". page=99: "There are no pets on this page." with "Go to the first page". page=abc: page 1.

Scenario: No search results
Preconditions: On /pets.
Steps:
1. Search for "zzzz".
2. Click "Clear filters".
Expected Result: "No pets match your search." with "Clear filters"; clearing shows all pets again and empties the search box.

Scenario: All QA containers are healthy and the app is reachable
Preconditions: QA stack started with `pnpm qa:up`.
Steps:
1. Run `pnpm qa:ps`.
2. Open http://127.0.0.1:3336/api/health.
3. Open http://127.0.0.1:4203.
Expected Result: mongodb, api and web are "healthy" and published on 127.0.0.1 only (ports 27019, 3336, 4203). Health returns {"status":"ok"}. The web app loads and shows the QA pets.

Scenario: Sign-in works between the built web app and the API
Preconditions: QA stack running and seeded (`pnpm qa:seed`).
Steps:
1. Sign in at http://127.0.0.1:4203 as ana@demo.example.com.
2. Refresh the page.
3. Open /applications.
Expected Result: You are signed in, still signed in after the refresh, and /applications loads. (This checks CORS, the session cookie on 127.0.0.1 and the API address built into the web image.) The same at http://localhost:4203 does not keep you signed in: that is expected, use 127.0.0.1.

Scenario: Deep links load directly (nginx)
Preconditions: QA stack running.
Steps:
1. Open a pet page, copy its URL, and open it in a new tab.
2. Refresh /applications and /does-not-exist.
Expected Result: The pet page and /applications load directly instead of an nginx 404. /does-not-exist shows the app's "Page not found".

Scenario: Photos are stored in the volume and survive a restart
Preconditions: QA stack running and seeded. A small photo without personal metadata.
Steps:
1. Signed in as Ana, create a pet named "QA Docker <date>" with the photo.
2. Run `pnpm qa:down`, then `pnpm qa:up`.
3. Reload the pet page.
Expected Result:
The photo shows before and after the restart (URL under http://127.0.0.1:3336/uploads/pets/): stopping the QA stack keeps its data.
Cleanup: Delete the "QA Docker" pet, or run `pnpm qa:reset --yes` and `pnpm qa:seed`.

Scenario: Uploaded photos lose their location data and stay upright
Preconditions: Signed in as Owner. A phone photo (JPEG) taken with location on, ideally held upright (portrait). On your computer, check that it has location data first (Windows: right-click → Properties → Details shows a GPS section). Seed data: Ana, on a pet she created for this.
Steps:
1. Edit the pet, click "Add photos", choose the photo and click "Save changes".
2. On the pet page, open the photo in a new tab and save it (right-click → Save image as).
3. Open the saved file's Properties → Details.
Expected Result: The photo is the right way up on the pet page and in the saved file. The saved file has no GPS section and no camera make or model, and its longest side is at most 2000 pixels. (The server re-encodes every upload; the original file is never stored.)

Scenario: Make the first admin from the command line
Preconditions: QA stack running and seeded. A PowerShell terminal in the repository root. First run: if the command can't connect to the QA database, log the case as Blocked with the error.
Steps:
1. In the app, register "QA Admin" with admin@qa.example.com and stay signed in.
2. In PowerShell: `$env:MONGODB_URI = "mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019/pet-adoption-qa?directConnection=true"`, then `pnpm admin:grant admin@qa.example.com` (dry run).
3. Check the output, then run `pnpm admin:grant admin@qa.example.com --yes`.
4. Refresh the browser, open the account menu and choose "Admin".
5. In PowerShell: `Remove-Item Env:MONGODB_URI`.
Expected Result:
The dry run prints "Database: 127.0.0.1:27019/pet-adoption-qa" and "User: QA Admin <admin@qa.example.com>, role: user", and changes nothing. After `--yes` and a refresh, the account menu shows "Admin" without signing in again. /admin shows "Administration" with Overview, Users, Pets, Applications and Audit log.
Cleanup: none; ADMIN-003 to ADMIN-005 use this account. `pnpm qa:reset --yes` removes it (the last admin can't be revoked).

Scenario: Ordinary users and visitors cannot use the admin area
Preconditions: Signed in as an ordinary user, e.g. Marko.
Steps:
1. Open the account menu (your name in the header).
2. Open http://127.0.0.1:4203/admin and http://127.0.0.1:4203/admin/users directly.
3. Sign out and open /admin again.
Expected Result: The menu has no "Admin" item. Both admin URLs show "Admins only" with "Back to pets", and no user, pet or application data appears. Signed out, /admin sends you to sign in.

Scenario: Suspend and reinstate a user
Preconditions: Signed in as the admin from ADMIN-001 in one window. In a private window, register member@qa.example.com ("QA Member") and stay signed in.
Steps:
1. As admin: Admin → Users, search "member", click "Suspend", enter a reason, click "Yes, suspend".
2. In the member's window, reload the page.
3. Try to sign in as the member again.
4. As admin, click "Reinstate", then "Yes, reinstate".
5. Sign in as the member.
Expected Result: Toast "QA Member is suspended." and a "Suspended" badge on the user. After the reload the member is signed out (the header shows "Sign in"). Signing in shows "This account is suspended. Contact the site administrators if you think this is a mistake." After reinstating: toast "QA Member can sign in again.", and the member can sign in.

Scenario: Hide and restore a listing
Preconditions: The admin from ADMIN-001 in one window. In another window, Ana creates a pet named "QA Hidden" for this case. A third, signed-out window as Visitor.
Steps:
1. As admin: Admin → Pets, search "QA Hidden", click "Hide listing", enter a reason, click "Yes, hide".
2. As Visitor: search /pets for "QA Hidden", then open the pet's address.
3. As Ana: open the pet.
4. As admin: click "Restore listing", then "Yes, restore".
5. As Visitor: search /pets again.
Expected Result:
Toast "QA Hidden is hidden." The Visitor no longer finds it, and its address shows the pet-not-found page. Ana still sees the pet with "Administrators hid this listing. Only you and the administrators can see it, and it takes no new applications. You can still decide existing applications." After restoring: toast "QA Hidden is public again.", and the Visitor finds it.
Cleanup: Ana deletes "QA Hidden".

Scenario: The audit log records admin actions
Preconditions: ADMIN-001, ADMIN-003 and ADMIN-004 done in this run.
Steps:
1. As admin: Admin → Audit log.
2. Filter by "Suspensions", then by "Hidden listings".
3. Look at the overview's "Recent admin activity".
Expected Result: The log lists "The command line changed QA Admin from User to Admin", "QA Admin suspended QA Member", "QA Admin reinstated QA Member", "QA Admin hid the listing QA Hidden" and "QA Admin restored the listing QA Hidden", each marked "Done", with "Reason: …" where one was given. List views appear as e.g. "QA Admin viewed the user list". The filters narrow the list. Entries have no edit or delete controls.

Scenario: Message the owner about a pet
Preconditions: Signed in as Adopter, with no earlier conversation about the pet. Seed data: Jelena opens Ana's Bella (demo data has no conversations; afterwards Jelena has one about Bella, so reset QA to repeat the first-message part).
Steps:
1. Open the pet and look at the "Listed by" section.
2. Click "Message the owner", then "Send message" with the box empty.
3. Write a message and click "Send message".
4. Go back to the pet page.
Expected Result: "Listed by" shows the owner's name (Ana Petrović), "View profile" and "Message the owner". The form is labelled "Your message to Ana Petrović" with the hint "Ask a question before you apply. Your email address is not shared." An empty send shows "Please write a message." and sends nothing. After sending: toast "Message sent." and you land on "Conversation with Ana Petrović", where your message is marked "You" with its date and time. Back on the pet page the button reads "Continue conversation" and opens the same conversation.

Scenario: Owner and adopter exchange messages
Preconditions: MSG-001 done. The owner (Ana) signed in in a second (private) window.
Steps:
1. As the owner, open the account menu and choose "Messages".
2. Open the conversation and send a reply.
3. In the adopter's window, reload the conversation page (or switch back to that window).
